reviews.text: SO, this thing is absolutely A-MA-ZING. I know you're thinking blablabla you're saying this because society is horrible and you want your money to be good, I know little flower I know but LISTEN TO ME (Im honestly so excited rn). My nose is basically a glorified strawberry and this just transformed my skin into some baby butt skin and I AM FLOURED. There are still the bigger ones (I hate them so much) but in only 2 weeks I saw so much difference i am shooketh. I didn't have a lot of whiteheads, so I'm sorry but I can't help you with that. ALSO LET IT SIT ON YOUR CUTE LITTLER FACE FOR 30 MINUTES. REALLY. You may be like me and just behave like a little thug and apply your cream straight after buT DONT. I saw so much improvement in two (2) days with that. Improvement that weren't there aLL WEEK LONG. SO LISTEN TO ME. AND LET. IT. SIT.
reviews.zh: 所以，呢樣嘢真係 A-MA-ZING。我知你諗緊 blablabla，你會話我係因為社會好差先咁講，又或者我想我啲錢畀得值，我知，小花，我知，但係聽我講啦（我而家真係好興奮）。我個鼻基本上就係一粒美化咗嘅草莓，而呢樣嘢將我嘅皮膚變成咗嬰兒屁股咁嘅皮膚，我整個人都驚呆咗！大粒嘅痘仲有（我好憎佢哋），但係短短兩個星期入面，我見到好大嘅分別，我好驚訝。我冇好多白頭，所以唔好意思，呢方面我幫唔到你。另外，請讓佢喺你可愛嘅小臉上留足 30 分鐘。真係！你可能同我一樣，好似小混混咁，塗完面霜就即刻再塗面霜，但係唔好（DON'T）！用咗呢個方法，兩日內我就見到好大改善，係成個星期都未見過嘅改善。所以聽我講。同埋聽我講，讓佢留住（LET. IT. SIT.）。

reviews.text: I've tried lots of different facial products to get rid of my acne and the small bumps on my forehead and only this one seems to work well. I've been using this for 3 or 4 months now and I see a drastic difference with my skin. I have oily skin and I think it controls the oil production throughout the day, and that's probably what reduces the amount of acne. I do get the occasional acne here and there, but I've noticed that they go away faster. Overall, loving this product and I'm buying a second bottle, even though I still have 1/4 of product left (which will probably last me another 2 months or so).
reviews.zh: 我試過好多唔同嘅面部產品，想去除暗瘡同額頭上嘅細粒，但係只有呢款睇落有效。我用咗呢款三至四個月，我嘅皮膚有好大嘅分別。我皮膚油，我諗佢可以控制成日嘅出油，而呢個可能就係減少暗瘡嘅原因。我間中都會長少少暗瘡，但係我留意到佢哋消失得快咗。總括嚟講，我好鍾意呢款產品，而家買緊第二樽，即使我手上仲有四分之一嘅產品（可能仲夠用多兩個月左右）。

reviews.text: I've tried so many products to clear up my acne, and after using it for about 2 weeks, I've definitely seen my skin clearing up! I also use this with the St. Ives apricot scrub, but it was definitely this product that did the trick. I usually have combination skin, and this product helps keep the oil under control. I used to have small pimples on my forehead (the ones that look like they're under the skin) and they're gone now! I highly recommend this product
reviews.zh: 我試過好多產品去清除暗瘡，用咗大約兩個星期之後，我肯定見到皮膚開始變清晰！我同時都有用 St. Ives 杏桃磨砂膏，但係真正發揮作用嘅絕對係呢款產品。我通常係混合性皮膚，呢款產品幫我控制油脂。我以前額頭上有啲細粒（睇落好似埋喺皮膚底下嗰種），而家已經冇咗！我強烈推薦呢款產品。

reviews.text:
I have oily, combination skin with slightly sensitised skin.
Used it every day for a couple months to test it out and noticed a major difference in the blackheads and whiteheads on my nose area. They were mostly gone and my pores were minimised. 
Helped a lot with the flaky skin I have from fresh acne scars and dry skin in general - when I applied it, the flaky skin was gone!
I stopped using it to see what difference it actually made. After just 2 days, noticed my nose pores were bigger, the whiteheads were more prominent and blackheads were more prevalent.
Product also lasts a long time, even after every day use - still have 1/4 of the bottle left since September. 
Overall, the exfoliation was mild - didn't feel anything and really helped with dry, flaky skin and reduction of blackheads and whiteheads (practically gone).
reviews.zh:
我皮膚油性、混合性，而且有啲輕微敏感，偶爾會有啲泛紅。
我每日用咗幾個月去測試，留意到鼻位嘅黑頭同白頭有好大嘅分別。佢哋大部分都冇咗，毛孔亦都縮細咗。
佢幫助咗我因為新暗瘡疤痕同皮膚乾燥而起嘅起皮問題，我塗咗之後，起皮嘅位置都冇咗。
我停咗用，睇吓會有咩分別。大約兩日之後，我發現鼻毛孔大咗，白頭更加明顯，黑頭就更加多。
呢款產品都好耐用，即使每日用，由九月開始用到而家，仲剩四分之一支。
總括嚟講，去角質嘅力度好溫和，我唔覺得有咩感覺，但係真係幫助咗乾燥起皮，同減少黑頭同白頭（幾乎冇晒）。

reviews.text: I must admit, initially I did not like this toner; it was not a terrible toner, but I just didn't realize how much it was doing for my skin. However, when I stopped using this toner for a couple of days (I usually use it at night), I realized how much acne it cleared out. Some recommendations for using the product would be: as it is an acid toner, avoid using in the daytime because of sun exposure, spritz the product onto a cotton pad and then apply to face to maximize product, be careful to watch for sensitivity - this is an acid toner, and some people may be more sensitive to the AHA/BHA in this product. I really love this product and I highly recommend it!
reviews.zh: 我要承認，起初我唔太鍾意呢款化妝水；佢唔係差，但係我當時唔明白佢幫我皮膚做咗幾多嘢。不過，當我停咗用佢幾日（我通常晚上用）之後，我先意識到佢清除咗好多暗瘡。以下有幾個使用建議：因為佢係酸性化妝水，日間盡量唔好用，避免受陽光照射；將產品噴喺化妝棉上面，然後再塗喺面上，可以令產品發揮最大效用；留意皮膚會唔會敏感——呢款係酸性化妝水，部分人可能對入面嘅 AHA/BHA 比較敏感。我真係好鍾意呢款產品，極力推薦！

reviews.text: This is a very nice toner, it is very refreshing and doesn't feel like anything on the skin after it has dried and leaves no residue. I like to use it with a cotton pad if I want a bit more exfoliation or then spray it onto my face if my skin is more sensitive. It doesn't t dry out your skin but I wouldn't say it is super hydrating either. It is just a nice refreshing toner that is perfect to tone your skin after cleansing. It is very gentle, doesn't irritate the skin and doesn't have a strong scent. I have acne prone oily sensitive skin and this didn't break me out. However it is not enough to keep the acne on bay so in case of acne it should still be used in conjunction with other products.
reviews.zh: 呢款化妝水好好，清新得嚟，乾咗之後塗喺皮膚上完全冇任何感覺，亦唔會留低殘留物。如果我想去角質多啲，我會用化妝棉拍；如果我皮膚比較敏感，就噴喺面上。佢唔會令皮膚乾燥，但我唔會話佢好保濕。佢只係一款清新嘅化妝水，清潔之後用嚟平衡皮膚就最啱。佢非常溫和，唔會刺激皮膚，亦冇好濃嘅香味。我係易生暗瘡、油性、敏感嘅皮膚，呢款冇令我爆痘。不過，佢唔足以令暗瘡受控，所以如果有暗瘡，仍然應該配合其他產品一齊用。

reviews.text:
This toner is fantastic and it helps with whiteheads, blackheads and blemishes. Really good with cleansing your skin and very gentle and especially recommended for those who have acne prone skin.
It is more recommended to use it in your night time routine as it contains AHA/BHA (acids), making your skin more sensitive to UVA and UVB. The first time that I used these ( a newbie in skincare), it worsened my freckles and sun spots even if my pimples were completely gone. Now I only use this every night or just one/two times a week in my morning routine including a 50+++ sunscreen. Overall, still very recommended if used correctly.
reviews.zh:
呢款化妝水好好，可以幫助處理白頭、黑頭同暗瘡。用嚟潔面非常好，而且非常溫和，特別推薦畀易生暗瘡嘅皮膚。
我建議晚上用，因為佢含有 AHA/BHA（酸），會令皮膚對 UVA 同 UVB 更加敏感。我第一次用呢款（作為護膚新手），令我嘅雀斑同曬斑都變得更嚴重，即使我嘅暗瘡已經完全消失。而家我只係每晚用，或者每星期一至兩次早上用，並且一定配合 50+++ 防曬。總括嚟講，如果用得啱，仍然非常推薦。

reviews.text: I have sensitive skin and really hesitate to try new products out as I have acne prone skin and I get dry patches easily due to chemicals in products. This not only cleared up my skin, it keeps it hydrated, clean and soft. Not only has it reduced break-outs (close to no break outs now), it has soothed my skin and lightened up scars, it has also gotten rid of tiny bumps and brighten up my complexion. It feels very refreshing even during the cold winter. I use this day and night after cleaning my face and then I use an essence on top, I only use a moisturiser if I have dry patches - as they tend to clog my pore. I definitely recommend this product! I have made 3 purchases and will likely be making more.
reviews.zh: 我皮膚敏感，而且好猶豫去試新產品，因為我易生暗瘡，又因為產品入面嘅化學成分，我好容易會起乾燥嘅斑塊。呢款唔單止清走咗我嘅暗瘡，仲保持咗水分、清潔同柔軟。佢減少咗爆痘（而家幾乎冇爆痘），亦都舒緩咗我嘅皮膚，淡化咗疤痕，仲有幫助我消除細粒，令我嘅膚色更明亮。喺寒冷嘅冬天，用起嚟都好清爽。我日夜都係潔面之後用，然後再用精華，只有皮膚乾嘅位置先會用保濕霜，因為佢哋容易堵塞毛孔。我絕對推薦呢款產品！我已經買咗三次，相信會繼續買。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
